propositions: Security detector matches are silently dropped when location.file and changed_files entries denote the same file but use different path spellings (relative vs absolute, repeated separators, unicode variants).
The diff-scope membership test compares location.file against changed_files entries without normalization, causing exact-string inequality for semantically identical paths.
Both location.file and changed_files entries must be canonicalized (relativized under repo_root, normpath-collapsed, NFC-normalized) before the membership test to retain high-severity matches.

A canonical-path function must relativize absolute paths under repo_root, collapse ./‌ and repeated separators, and normalize unicode to NFC form, without invoking filesystem calls or symlink resolution.
Tests must verify that variant path forms (./app.py, absolute paths, a//b.py, unicode NFC/NFD) all match their canonical entry, while genuinely different files remain unmatched.
